name: Task Master
upstream_status_note: No release and no repository activity in the 180 days before 2026-11-14.
outcome_statement: As of 2026-11-14: meets C1, C4, C6, C7, C10; partly meets C2, C5, C8; does not meet C3, C9.

findings.title: Source and release provenance
findings.finding: The npm record for task-master-ai@0.43.1 names the repository `git+https://github.com/eyaltoledano/claude-task-master.git` and carries a provenance attestation (`dist.attestations`).

findings.title: Published security policy
findings.finding: GitHub's security-policy page for the repository says "No security policy detected"; the same page offers private vulnerability reporting ("Report a vulnerability").

findings.title: Maintenance status
findings.finding: The repository is not archived, but there has been neither a release nor repository activity in the 180 days before 2026-11-14. Latest release 0.43.1 is dated 2026-03-31; the newest commit on `main` is dated 2026-04-23; GitHub reports the last push on 2026-04-28.

findings.title: Published advisories
findings.finding: No advisory is published in the repository's advisory list.

findings.title: Documented scope controls
findings.finding: All tools are loaded by default; the README documents an environment variable that loads a subset. Quoted: “By default, all 36 tools are loaded (~21,000 tokens) to maintain backward compatibility with existing installations.”.

findings.title: Credential handling in the documented setup
findings.finding: Provider API keys are supplied in the MCP client's `env` block. Quoted: “"ANTHROPIC_API_KEY": "YOUR_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY_HERE"”.

findings.title: Telemetry and outbound data, as documented
findings.finding: The README contains no reference to telemetry or usage collection; the documented function calls the model providers the user configures. Searched `README.md` for: telemetry, usage statistics, usage stats, we collect, data collection, opt-out, posthog.

findings.title: Dependency management files
findings.finding: A lockfile (`package-lock.json`) is committed. No Dependabot or Renovate configuration file exists at the paths listed in the methodology.

findings.title: Documentation of untrusted-content risk
findings.finding: No statement about prompt injection or untrusted content was found in the files searched. Searched `README.md` for: prompt-injection, untrusted, malicious, attacker, adversarial.

findings.title: Currency of the declared MCP library
findings.finding: Declared MCP library: fastmcp ^3.23.1. Lower-bound version 3.23.1 of fastmcp (npm) was published on 2025-11-17, within the 12 months before 2026-11-14.
